About this look

The runway statement: graphic lines, sculpted light and an unexpected finish. Editorial is where the house experiments, then distils it into something you can wear.

The direction

  • Graphic, sculpted lines
  • High-contrast light and shadow
  • A signature statement finish

How to recreate it

  1. Sculpt the face with a defined contour and bright highlight.
  2. Draw a clean, graphic line along the eye.
  3. Load the lashes for volume and lift.
  4. Choose one bold focal point and keep the rest refined.
